$comment: The source of sf-empty-state's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/empty-state (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

kind.summary: The reason, which picks the default icon, title and text, and for error a «Повторить» action.

size.summary: 1/3 is always the inline form; 1/2 inside a table or panel, 2 for a whole page: the icon, title role, text and gaps follow.

heading-level.summary: The title's outline level; its look follows the size.

layout.summary: inline: one line for a list inside a menu, a dropdown or a search -- a small icon, the words and at most one link action, no heading.

live.summary: auto: nothing-found and error are a polite status, the others say nothing; alert: an error the person caused; off: the host announces it.

actions.x-summary: The buttons to draw, each sending action {id}; unset, an error offers «Повторить» (id retry)

action.summary: The person pressed one of the actions (retry for an error without actions of its own).

actions.$comment: Plain page buttons drawn before the actions list; they ask through the page's own handlers (§4.5).

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.$comment: live auto: nothing-found and error are a polite status, the others say nothing; live alert: role alert (an error the person caused); live off: no role, the host announces. The name is the heading, the kind's words of the language file when unset; it is a real heading at heading-level in the block form, none in the inline form. Enter and Space belong to the action buttons (role button), not to the empty state.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-empty-state for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), detail-adds (the new detail holds the old fields), attribute-and-property, host-attribute (no shim), manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), retired (no new name; kept and noted by the component until the date).

rows.note: the DOM name and the detail {id} stay; the manifest declares the verb action
rows.summary: The person pressed one of the actions (retry for an error without actions of its own).

x-summary: What a list, a panel or a page says when it has nothing to show: no data, nothing found, no access or an error, with an icon, a real heading, a sentence and actions.
x-renamed: settings.title → heading: "title" is a property of HTMLElement.prototype (§3.1, §16 item 26), alias dated
events.sf-empty-state-action → action (the DOM name without sf-<tag>-)
x-decisions: own-verb-words: action is a verb of the empty state alone (the person pressed one of its buttons; detail.id names which, retry for the default of an error); its word is lang events.action.label. The vocabulary's retry repeats one write with its key, which this is not.
version: 1.0.0 → 1.1.0: title is a dated alias of heading, heading-level is a number, actions is declared; a minor while the alias holds (§4.10).
key-effects: the role is status (a live region) and gives no keys; Enter and Space press the action buttons, which are buttons of their own (sf-button), so the empty state maps only Tab: reach.

a11y-role: status written with when {live: auto, kind: nothing-found | error}; live alert gives role alert, live off and the other kinds no role (otherwise none). The name is the heading, else the kind's words of the language file.
number-type: heading-level is an integer 2..6 (§16 item 29; §7.4.1 a heading takes its level from heading-level).
actions: the list setting the element already had as a property, declared with its entries {id, text, appearance}; the slot actions holds plain page buttons.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json plus each kind, the inline form and the actions; probe.json drives the retry button, the live roles, the heading level and the alias.
skeleton: none; the empty state is what shows when data came and was empty; it has no port and no late data of its own (§5.4).
css-variables: six public variables read by its own sheet with the role token as fallback (src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json).

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.1.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.1.4: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.1.5: the no-data wording is a finished sentence (ru «Записей пока нет» / «Они появятся здесь, когда их добавят», en «No records yet» / «They will appear here once added»); the first-paint snapshots carry it. Asked by Larena storage review (2026-10-28).

actions.description: Set as a property: [{id, text, appearance}], drawn at the component's size; each raises sf-empty-state-action {id}. Slot `actions` takes the host's own buttons instead.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: saving the width on a server

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-empty-state wherever a list, panel or page has nothing to show, choosing the kind for the reason.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not show an empty state while data is still loading; that is the skeleton's
Do not hand-build an empty message with a paragraph

accessibility.focus: The block title is a heading at heading-level; the inline form has no heading. With live=auto nothing-found and error are announced politely (role=status), the others are not; live=alert makes it an alert, live=off silent. The icon is decorative; the actions are ordinary buttons in the tab order. Inside a listbox or menu, place it outside the list element so it is never an item.
